Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Vidhan Parishad has released the score card for the post of Office Attendant. This recruitment was issued for 24 posts. The Phase-II Exam was conduct on 25 May 2026. Online applying process for Bihar Vidhan Parishad Driver, Office Attendant Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 29 September 2025 to 20 October 2025. Candidates who appeared for Phase-II examination can check their Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 25 September 2025
  • Application Start Date : 29 September 2025
  • Last Date : 20 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 21 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 17 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 02 January 2026
  • Result : 28 April 2026
  • Phase-II Exam Date : 25 May 2026
  • Phase-II Admit Card : 21 May 2026
  • Phase-II Result : 03 June 2026
  • Phase-II Revised Final Result : 04 June 2026
  • DV Date (Driver) : 09 June 2026
  • Office Attendant Score Card : 19 September 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
